# `Q-18-16` — Interactive Widget Not Supported

> A code cell shows an interactive widget that Quarto cannot draw yet, so
> the page shows its text representation instead.

## What this means

Some Jupyter packages, such as ipywidgets, show an interactive control or
chart in a cell's output. To draw it on a page, Quarto needs the widget's
saved state, and it does not capture that state yet.

This warning means that one cell produced such a widget. The page shows the
widget's text representation (for example `IntSlider(value=3)`) in its
place. The render continues, and the rest of the output in the document is
unaffected.

## How to fix

Replace the widget with a static output in that cell, such as a plot or a
table. Or accept the text representation.

Use `--strict` to make this warning stop the render:

```bash
q2 render --strict
```
